english.note: Use this colloquial intensifying phrase when something is extremely boring rather than physically dangerous.

examples.english: This movie was deadly boring; I fell asleep after half an hour.
examples.traditional: 呢套戲悶到死，我睇咗半個鐘就瞓着喇。
